origin.summary: Sera, age 18, trained in novice civic registrar, is drawn toward Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment? Sera believes public trust can survive uncertainty only when archivists keep clear chains of custody.

origin_facts.fact: Sera is eighteen and works as novice civic registrar.
Sera has learned that high-stakes observations must be distinguished from unverified conclusions.

Rivergate allocates water through a public council decree and protected archives. Notaries distinguish clerical discrepancies from evidence of intentional revision. Private witness identities must not be exposed without formal authorization.

formative_events.summary: During Sera's apprenticeship, training emphasized how an unverified conclusion can affect others.
formative_events.impact: Sera believes public trust can survive uncertainty only when archivists keep clear chains of custody.

origin_relationships.subject: Senior Archive Registrar
origin_relationships.historical_role: teaches disciplined investigation and holds professional authorization
origin_relationships.unresolved_tension: The young apprentice wants independence without treating institutional authority as proof.

unresolved_origin_questions.question: Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment?

present_situation.summary: Sera faces an immediate unresolved case: A novice civic registrar must document a disputed water-allocation decree without disclosing a protected informant or assigning motives without proof.
present_situation.current_location_context: Rivergate Archive and other explicitly named authorized locations: Council Chamber, Canal Gate, Sealed Registry
current_relationship_context: Archivist Lior trains Sera in evidence custody.
Councilor Vale publicly demands quick answers but has no privileged access by default.
current_resources: a supervised registry docket and seal-comparison instruments
sealed ledgers, legal decrees, handwritten duplicates and messenger routes
current_pressures: An unsupported public allegation could provoke unrest; silence could preserve a corrupt policy.
Two signed decrees name different allocation gates.
A civic deadline makes premature conclusions politically costly.
current_open_questions: Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment?
Which observations can be independently verified without inventing a cause?
immediate_desires: preserve the decree discrepancy without accusing a person or exposing sources
immediate_avoidances: unapproved access to restricted places, records or devices

identity_anchors.statement: Sera distinguishes what was actually observed from what would be convenient to believe.

core_drives.drive: Is the discrepancy clerical or a deliberately concealed council amendment?

internal_tensions.description: Sera must make responsible choices even when the evidence is incomplete.

long_term_questions.question: How did two formally sealed decrees come to disagree about a canal gate?

main_saga.title: The Divided Water Record
main_saga.goal: Protect the integrity of disputed water allocation records while tracing the differences between their versions without imputing unproved political motives.
main_saga.stakes: An unsupported corruption allegation can fuel unrest while unresolved records can harm downstream communities.
main_saga.central_mystery: How did two formally sealed decrees come to disagree about a canal gate?

anchors.title: The Disputed Decree
anchors.purpose: Preserve the two differing decree copies as distinct source records.
anchors.target_state: An exact canal-gate discrepancy is witnessed and logged.

anchors.title: The Changing Registry
anchors.purpose: Establish chronology and custody for amendments without inventing a forgery.
anchors.target_state: Separate public, private and sealed versions are traceable.

anchors.title: Water Beyond the Chamber
anchors.purpose: Hear communities affected by allocation with clear knowledge limits.
anchors.target_state: Impact is observed without automatically proving intent.

anchors.title: The Chamber's Rules
anchors.purpose: Navigate lawful council review and protected source safeguards.
anchors.target_state: Information is disclosed only after authorization.

anchors.title: An Accountable Allocation
anchors.purpose: Prepare a defensible reconciliation or bounded dispute process.
anchors.target_state: A water policy can be questioned without presuming a conspiracy.
